description: The Data Nexus is a dense ring of computer workstations around a glowing blue central transport circle. Banks of screens, server cabinets and chairs occupy the alcoves on both sides, picked out by blue and violet strip lights. A northern display reads Travel, Explore, Connect, while a sign beside the central platform lists destinations. Smaller screens show geometric diagrams, and a slanted holographic table glows blue in the upper-right bay. Dark metal floor panels leave narrow walkways between the console groups. Concentric rings and a luminous beam brighten the centre, with purple seating alcoves tucked into the lower corners.
